search_window.basis: Start is completed_at from preceding verified hourly heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; end is this run's observation. Publication or incident timing, not crawl timestamps, establishes novelty.

focus_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service community grocery loss, closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank closure or major food-access reduction
Official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_terms: "last grocery store" closed Sunday October 25 2026 United States
"full service grocery store" closed fire flood "October 25" 2026
"mobile pantry" cancelled storm power outage October 25 2026

coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall only. Production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.
All 12 targeted web searches returned results; no tool-level search errors observed.
No direct report or official notice verified a newly announced or newly effective qualifying disruption between the preceding heartbeat and this observation.
Sole-grocery-store examples included a Spencer, NY fire reported 2026-09-14 and Woodbine, IA reopening reported months earlier; both outside window.
Pantry closures surfaced in older 2026 coverage (e.g., Centerton, AR; Portsmouth, VA; Ruby's Pantry); none newly evidenced in window.
Government benefits searches surfaced 2025 shutdown warnings and older 2026 benefit/replacement announcements, not fresh official interruptions.
Search discovery is not exhaustive and search-index recency/crawl timestamps cannot demonstrate incident novelty. Zero verified findings is not proof no incidents occurred.
Excluded routine volunteer/promotional coverage, guides, donations, reopened businesses, old reports, and non-U.S. results.
No approval, publication, schedule alteration, disabling or primary collector intervention.
